name: Steamed Yellow Crookneck Squash (Peeled & Sliced)
whyItWorks: Young crookneck squash with thin exterior peeled off and soft internal seeds scooped out, steamed until meltingly tender. High water content and gentle on colon tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel outer skin with a peeler, cut into rounds, and steam over simmering water for 8–10 minutes until completely tender.
